name: vault-brain
description: Persistent brain over an Obsidian vault: tiny always-loaded index, background Sonnet capture before /compact and at session end, on-demand recall.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/scripts/inject.mjs"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/scripts/capture.mjs"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/scripts/capture.mjs"
